title: Pay at least $18.00 an hour (Montgomery County, 51+ employees)
summary: Since July 1, 2026, large employers (51 or more employees) in Montgomery County must pay at least $18.00 per hour. Some 501(c)(3) nonprofits and home care providers pay the mid-size rate instead. Rates rise each July 1 with inflation.
action: Pay every employee at least $18.00 per hour and display the Montgomery County minimum wage poster.
agency: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights
sourceName: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights: Minimum wage

title: Pay at least $16.50 an hour (Montgomery County, 11 to 50 employees)
summary: Since July 1, 2026, mid-size employers (11 to 50 employees) in Montgomery County must pay at least $16.50 per hour. 501(c)(3) nonprofits and certain home care providers with 11 or more employees also use this rate. Rates rise each July 1 with inflation.
action: Pay every employee at least $16.50 per hour and display the Montgomery County minimum wage poster.
agency: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights
sourceName: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights: Minimum wage

title: Pay at least $15.95 an hour (Montgomery County, 10 or fewer employees)
summary: Since July 1, 2026, small employers (10 or fewer employees) in Montgomery County must pay at least $15.95 per hour, above the $15.00 state rate. Rates rise each July 1 with inflation.
action: Pay every employee at least $15.95 per hour and display the Montgomery County minimum wage poster.
agency: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights
sourceName: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights: Minimum wage

title: Tipped staff: pay at least $4.00 an hour, plus tips up to minimum wage (Montgomery County)
summary: In Montgomery County, tipped employees must be paid at least $4.00 per hour, and pay plus tips must reach the county minimum wage for your size. Restaurants using tips toward minimum wage must give a Tip Credit Wage Statement.
action: Pay tipped staff at least $4.00 per hour and make up any gap to the county minimum wage each pay period.
agency: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights
sourceName: Maryland Department of Labor: County minimum wage laws

title: Pay at least $16.00 an hour (Howard County)
summary: Since July 1, 2026, all employers in Howard County, of any size, must pay at least $16.00 per hour, above the $15.00 state rate.
action: Pay every employee at least $16.00 per hour and display the Howard County minimum wage poster.
sourceName: Maryland Department of Labor: County minimum wage laws

title: Pay at least $15.30 an hour (Prince George's County)
summary: As of July 1, 2026, all employers in Prince George's County, of any size, must pay at least $15.30 per hour, above the $15.00 state rate.
action: Pay every employee at least $15.30 per hour.
sourceName: Maryland Department of Labor: County minimum wage laws

title: Don't ask about criminal records until after a job offer (Baltimore City)
summary: Baltimore City employers with the equivalent of 10 or more full-time employees can't ask about or check criminal records until after making a conditional job offer. Part-time staff count toward full-time equivalents. Employers serving minors or vulnerable adults are exempt.
action: Remove criminal record questions from applications and wait until after a conditional offer to run background checks.
sourceName: Baltimore City Community Relations Commission: Ban the Box (Ordinance 14-221)
